policy_change_reason: Test dispositions 2026-10-15 (reports/forge/test-dispositions-20261015/README.md). gaussian1d_stability and ten more Tier 2 tests (four vector density, three image and three 100-blob tests) are held: still declared, run and shown, but not counted until one global recipe passes them together with every counted test. ring_hold leaves the count as a phase of ring_extension, the single counted ring endurance verdict. Revision 10 is skipped: committed research artifacts cite an unadopted 'revision10' draft that moved Gaussian retention to Tier 3, and this revision is not that draft. Recorded qualification stays at revision 9, archived byte for byte, until new ordinary evidence is registered; task gates and earlier grades are unchanged.
